Q5910.reason: A restriction barring construction on a utility strip creates a nonpossessory interest burdening the land at law, i.e., a negative easement.

Q5623.reason: The commentary concerned a matter of public interest and was privileged, so the professor cannot prevail on invasion of privacy.

Q5004.reason: The sister is a life in being, so all children born during her lifetime are included and the executory interest satisfies the Rule Against Perpetuities.
